question.text: Grameen Urja Pvt Ltd (rural solar, Section 8 company) shows an SROI of 3.8 computed using only direct-beneficiary household savings. The SE claims the ratio supports its impact narrative. As SIA, what is the FIRST check you should perform on this ratio?

answer.text: Verify the currency conversion rate to USD
Check whether the numerator nets out deadweight, displacement and attribution
Confirm the SE's PAN is valid
Re-compute using discounted cash flow at 10% WACC

explanation.text: **The Logic:** An SROI is valid only after netting deadweight (what would have happened anyway), displacement (benefit accruing to non-targets or crowding out), and attribution (share claimable by the SE). Chapter 7.4 highlights this as the #1 source of SROI overstatement. **The Trap:** A is clerical. C is basic KYC already done at onboarding. D imports DCF which is separate from SROI discounting and not the first-line check. **Cross-Exam Context:** Deadweight/displacement/attribution is the same taxonomy taught in Cabinet Office (UK) SROI Guide and in World Bank Impact Evaluation in Practice. **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** Build an SROI workpaper with four explicit lines: Gross Outcome, (-) Deadweight, (-) Displacement, (×) Attribution % = Net Impact. If any line is blank, reject the computation. This four-line template will save you from 90% of SROI disputes.
